name: AC Premium Auto
old_description: Find quality OEM and used auto parts fast from premium suppliers across the USA
about:
AC Premium Auto operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it sources and supplies used OEM automotive parts from a network of premium salvage yards across the United States. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business focuses on providing a broad inventory of recycled original-equipment components, including engines, transmissions, ABS control modules, rear axle assemblies, alternators, drive shafts, side-view mirrors, tail lights, and headlights. Each unit is described as tested, inspected, and verified for fitment and performance before shipment, offering a cost-effective alternative to new replacements.

Its customer base spans automotive repair shops, collision centers, and individual vehicle owners seeking reliable used parts with nationwide delivery. The company emphasizes its ability to ship parts quickly from its supplier network to locations throughout the country.

AC Premium Auto differentiates itself by stressing that all parts are OEM-approved, quality-tested, and backed by a verification process intended to ensure safety and durability at a lower price point than new components.
